faq.title: The answers, no detours.
faq.a1: Yes. The number next to the package is what you pay. We put it in writing before we start, and it won’t change midway.
faq.q2: What if I need more changes?
faq.a2: Two revision rounds are included in every package. If you need more, they have a fixed rate per round, written in the quote. No surprises.
faq.a3: Timelines are listed per package and start from the date you lock in. If your materials run late, the date moves with you.
faq.a4: Always. A proper invoice for every project and every month of social management.
faq.q5: My project is bigger. Can you do it?
faq.a5: Of course. Combine several packages, or ask for a custom quote — also at a fixed price, agreed before we start.

cta.title: Choose. Pay. Done
cta.lede: Tell us about the project in a 20-minute call. You leave with a price and a date, not a “we’ll get back to you”.
